abstract: Video-assisted endoscopic surgery has recently been expanding its potential, which is shown by our report herein describing the case of a 23-year-old woman for whom successful thoracoscopic resection of a mediastinal cystic lesion was carried out. The patient's postoperative course was uneventful with minimal pain and a prompt recovery. Histological examination confirmed that the lesion was a benign cystic teratoma. We believe that video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery will become the standard procedure for most mediastinal cystic lesions in the future.
abstract_ja: ビデオ補助内視鏡手術は近年その適応を広げつつあり、本稿では23歳女性の縦隔嚢胞性病変に対して胸腔鏡下切除に成功した症例を報告する。術後経過は順調で、疼痛は最小限にとどまり、速やかに回復した。病理組織学的検査により、病変は良性の嚢胞性奇形腫と確認された。ビデオ補助下胸腔鏡手術は、今後、縦隔嚢胞性病変の大半に対する標準術式となると考える。
